adjudication.resolution: Both disputes are UPHELD; the verdict remains NAMED, carried by name 1, with name 2 corrected rather than the difference split. Dispute 1 (classifying property credited without a source law): upheld under F-C1. The defining datum of an object classifier is the classifying equivalence (HoTT Book Theorem 4.8.3; Lurie HTT 6.1.6), which in HoTT is proved from univalence; the analyst's own notes correctly certify that stage 1 licenses no univalence-grade law, and the submitted law 2 ('genericity => classifying equivalence') manufactures the equivalence/uniqueness half out of a syntactic genericity datum that yields at most existence. The submitted name 2 is therefore void — resemblance is not naming — and its target is recorded as failed attempt 4, in exact parallel with the analyst's own correct rejection of the Steenrod universal-bundle target (attempt 3), which failed for the same reason at classical strength. Dispute 2 (label-to-law translation for natural-model representability): upheld. The row mapping kernel_head/intrinsic_kernel to 'representable map Tm -> Ty' was the sole source-side support for a defining property of the natural-model target, violating the glossary's instruction to translate content, never merely labels; it is struck with the name that needed it. Disposition of the second entry: the standard's synonyms provision, not compromise, decides the remedy. Both analyst and verifier agree the underlying families-fibrations correspondence (HoTT Book Lemmas 4.8.1-4.8.2, provable without univalence) is real and theorem-backed, and the verifier's audit itself identifies the classifier-free fibrational synonym as a legitimate second registry entry. The corrected entry names ONLY the display-map presentation of the same structure named by entry 1: every clause maps (base, fiber assignment, fiber evaluation), every source law becomes a genuine pre-univalence theorem (fiber formula, base-change stability, data-not-property, opacity of fibers), the forbidden label row is removed, and Theorem 4.8.3 / Lurie 6.1.6 / Awodey 2018 are removed from its citations because they define the rejected stronger target. This is F-C3's sanctioned direction — fix the name, never the family — and F-C2 is respected in both directions: no NO-NAME is suppressed (name 1 independently survives an adversarial audit as a full clause-preserving translation with real citations), and no forced match is retained (the over-claimed classifier name is demoted to a recorded obstruction rather than weakened in place by hedging). disputes.argument: The defining datum of an object classifier is not the universal family alone but the classifying LAW: pullback of the universal map induces an equivalence between maps X -> U0 and small families/fibrations over X (HoTT Book Thm 4.8.3; Lurie HTT 6.1.6 — these citations are real, which is exactly the problem: they define the target by the equivalence). Name 2's law 2 derives this equivalence from 'Genericity (abstraction over the first-use level Var 1)'. Abstraction over a free level is a syntactic genericity datum; at most it yields the existence direction (every instance of the clause is an instance of the generic family), never the equivalence/uniqueness half. In HoTT, Theorem 4.8.3 is proved from univalence, and object-classifier-hood is precisely the fibrational face of the univalence law. The analyst's own notes concede that stage 1 (two clauses, no path/Kan/HIT data) licenses NO univalence law and that claiming one 'would attach a theorem with no source law and would violate the standard in the opposite direction' — then name 2 does exactly that one level down, naming the target whose defining law is the univalence-grade equivalence while disclaiming the law. rows.notes: Decisive NF facts grounding the verdict, valid under every admissible reading of the ambient arity of the stage-14 telescope. (1) The anchored clause Pi(Lam(Var 1), Sigma(Var 1, Var 2)) is doubly NON-dependent: Var(k) are 1-based de Bruijn LEVELS over [ambient params, prior clause fields, binders], and with three prior clause fields (clauses 0-2) in scope any binder (Pi-argument, Sigma-first-component) sits at level >= 5, so neither Var 1 nor Var 2 in the codomain is a binder; the type is (sections of the constant family at level-1) -> (level-1 x level-2). (2) Clause 3 is the ONLY clause of the sealed candidate referencing context level 2 at all; abstracted over first-use free levels per the kernel glossary, the family is a two-parameter head c : Pi(Lam(X), Sigma(X, Y)) with X, Y abstract - a carrier-extraction head with an unexplained second output sort. (3) The Pi's domain position is occupied by a Lam - a function/family, not a type - so the formation is definitionally stuck in the beta-only kernel; this is consonant with the family's tags (kernel_head, axiomatic_introduction_head, intrinsic_kernel): an intrinsically stuck axiom head, not an internally derivable operation. (4) The stage grammar contains the scalar/Univ-valued functional shape elsewhere (clause 8: Lam(Pi(Var 1, Univ))) and this family does not use it, so the failure of the dual-space (Riesz) reading is not an expressivity artifact. Given the stage reading (complete inner-product state space and spectral/operator calculus), Riesz-Frechet representation was the tempting tidy identification and was examined first; it fails the standard on two independent counts (domain sort; witness dependency). Per F-C2 the mismatch is reported rather than repaired, and per F-C3 the family was not reinterpreted (in particular, it was not fused with the clause-0 inner-product field to manufacture the missing dependency, and clause 4's operator-pair datum was not merged in to rescue an adjoint-existence reading, which in any case fails because the Sigma's first component is the carrier, not an operator type). Verdict: NO-NAME after four independent attempts; the certified aspect is finer/stranger than any classical Hilbert-space datum consulted, which the study brief treats as the more interesting outcome.

adjudication.resolution: Dispute 1 SUSTAINED (F-C1): Name 2 (functor-level distributive law / exchange 2-cell) is struck as a name and demoted to a recorded attempt. The target's defining datum is a natural transformation, and in the Turi-Plotkin/Klin setting 'no equations' means no equations beyond naturality - the naturality squares are constitutive defining data. The certified family is a single postulated, definitionally stuck kernel head abstracted over one free level: no source clause maps to the naturality equation, no beta computation can ever witness one (modal/temporal heads are stuck by construction), and the analyst's bridge - 'uniform schematicity becomes the naturality-square condition' - attributes a law the audit did not certify; even univalent semantics yields only path/equivalence-naturality, strictly weaker than the all-morphisms naturality the cited bialgebraic targets require and use. This is exactly the defect the analyst's own Beck-level attempt policed, one level down, so consistency of the standard compels the same disposition. Per F-C2 the rejection is recorded, not suppressed: it becomes attempt 2 with the naturality obstruction named. The overall verdict remains NAMED, carried by Name 1 alone, which is granularity-matched: the defining data of an axiom scheme are its formula, its schematic variable, and its postulate status, and rows 1-3 of the translation cover them completely with real cite-checked theorems on the law side (product frames validate com; closure under uniform substitution; products properly extend fusions - GKWZ 2003). Dispute 2 SUSTAINED (minor, name wording): 'S5-like' is corrected to 'S4-like/lax closure modality' in the registered name string and the target description. The only laws invoked and supported by the citations are the unit (p -> Sharp p) and idempotence (Sharp Sharp p -> Sharp p) of an idempotent monadic modality - the laws of a lax/closure modality, corresponding to S4 via closure algebras - and no source datum or citation supports a symmetry-type S5 law. The com scheme is strength-agnostic, so the translation itself was never at risk; supporting citations (Fairtlough-Mendler 1997; McKinsey-Tarski 1944) were added for the corrected label. Two undisputed verifier notes adopted as corrections to the surviving entry: (a) the HoTT Book citation for propositions-as-types is corrected to sec. 1.11 (with sec. 1.4 retained for Pi-types); (b) the analyst's translation row 4 (marginality -> non-derivability from the fusion) is removed as a translation row - it targets a theorem, not a defining datum of the axiom scheme - and its content is retained where it belongs, as laws_as_theorems item 3, with a cross-reference in row 3's note. No split-the-difference outcome: Name 2 is fully void as a name (F-C1), Name 1 fully survives as corrected, and the family itself was not touched (F-C3).

laws_as_theorems: The declared clause (the inhabitant of the Pi, credited as kernel_head) becomes the soundness theorem: product frames F1 x F2 validate the commutation axiom M1 M2 p -> M2 M1 p, by the commuting-square (left/right commutativity) property of product relations (GKWZ 2003, products chapter).
Uniformity of the family NF in its abstracted free level becomes the theorem that the product logic is closed under uniform substitution of the schematic variable p.

The family's marginal_no_preimage credit becomes the classical theorem that products of modal logics properly extend their fusions: the commutation axiom is independent of the two component logics taken side by side (GKWZ 2003).

disputes.argument: The defining datum of a Turi-Plotkin/Klin functor-over-functor distributive law is a NATURAL transformation: the naturality squares (for arbitrary morphisms of the base category) are constitutive equations of the target, even though no FURTHER equations are imposed. The certified family is a single clause - a postulated, definitionally stuck kernel_head of type Pi(Sharp(Eventually(Var 1)), Eventually(Sharp(Var 1))) abstracted over one free level - and no source datum maps to the naturality equation. The analyst plugs the gap by asserting (Name 2, law 1) that 'uniform schematicity of the family NF becomes the naturality-square condition', but schematic uniformity of a postulated constant does not entail naturality: in a beta-only kernel where modal/temporal heads are stuck by construction, no computation can ever witness a naturality square, and even under the intended univalent semantics a term of Pi(A:U). F A -> G A is automatically natural only with respect to paths/equivalences (the core-end), strictly weaker than the all-morphisms naturality that the cited bialgebraic targets require and use. This is a resemblance, not a mapping - precisely the defect the analyst's own attempt 1 policed at the Beck level ('naming at the monad level would attribute laws the audit did not certify'), committed one level down. Under F-C1 Name 2 as stated is void. Honest remediations: (a) demote Name 2 to a recorded attempt with obstruction 'resembles the functor-level distributive law but the naturality equation has no certified counterpart clause', or (b) restate the target as the bare schematic component datum - which is exactly what Name 1 already names. The overall 'named' verdict can survive on Name 1 alone; Name 2 must be struck or demoted.

Stuckness law (Flat and Next are stuck by construction; beta is the only computation rule, so the declared head satisfies no definitional equations) becomes the theorem-level fact that lambda is extra structure on the composite functors: on the target side no equation relates lambda to evaluation/beta, exactly as for a 2-cell between composites of right-adjoint-type modalities.

Existence/consistency of the declared datum becomes a theorem in the standard model: in topos-of-trees-style guarded models equipped with a discreteness (flat) comonad, flat(later A) is canonically isomorphic to flat(A) (constant/global objects absorb the delay), and the component lambda_A factors as next_{flat A} o (that comparison) — so the axiomatized map is a theorem of the model (Birkedal-Mogelberg-Schwinghammer-Stovring 2012; Clouston-Bizjak-Grathwohl-Birkedal 2016).
